dialogues.speaker: Illuga's Books
dialogues.text: (There are a few books on the table...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (These all look like books that <color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> would read...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (These all look like books that <color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> would read...)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: It's a book I've read before...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: "Adventure in Arianrhod"... That's the fairy tale the old man got me when I was a kid... Am I too old for something like that now?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Lately, though, while playing Tabletop Troupe with the others, I've noticed that several parts of the game's plot are quite similar to that book's story. I guess it might be popular in other nations?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I should re-read when I have the time. Maybe it'll help me the next time I play Tabletop Troupe.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Ah, this is the compilation of past intel on Wild Hunt activity... I should include that last report in here too.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Most folks believe the Wild Hunt appears out of nowhere. But thanks to our long-term observation records, we're finally starting to see some patterns.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: There are certain spots where the Wild Hunt is more likely to surface. Those are the spots we need to keep a closer eye on.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: This knowledge has come at considerable cost... We must make sure that every single record is retained.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: "A Culinary Journey Through Teyvat" — I may have read this several times already, but I discover something new each time.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But cooking is not just about following recipes down to the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Cooking ingredients can taste different depending on their origin, and the same dish can also turn out completely different when you change the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And the book doesn't mention any ingredients we have here in Nod-Krai... Looks like I'll just have to experiment.
